strings.cbAmazonS3CustomCNAME.ToolTip:
Use this option if you have a bucket set up with a custom domain.
If text field is empty then bucket name will be used for URL.
For example, if your bucket is called "bucket.example.com" then URL will be "http://bucket.example.com/...".
